bibliographic.title: The only thing we have left
bibliographic.author: actias_moon
bibliographic.description:
Short interactive story about surviving in a post apocalyptic world and dealing with the aftermath of your choices.

Created for Neo-Twiny Jam 2026 with Twine.  497 words.

Made with Twine.

Content warning: themes of death, graphic depiction of injury/illness, survivor's-guilt,  reference to suicide.

Background image https://www.pexels.com/photo/dimly-lit-abandoned-industrial-warehouse-interior-3... by Mike Norris.
